features.name: Outcome-Driven Project Showcase
features.description: Hardcoded bento-grid portfolio displaying case studies for regulated industries with a clear 'Outcome -> Problem -> Solution' structure.
acceptance_criteria: Case studies lead with a bold outcome metric (the 'hook')
Each project includes distinct sections for Outcome, Problem, and Solution
Visual design uses modern, 'disruptive' elements (grids, glassmorphism)
Staggered entry animations using Framer Motion
Responsive layout optimized for high-end desktop and mobile devices
features.notes: No CMS; projects are statically defined in the codebase for maximum control.

features.name: Direct Contact Page
features.description: Clean, high-conversion contact page with clear ways for prospects to initiate manual 1-to-1 SMS or Email outreach.
acceptance_criteria: Contact options include SMS and Email with direct links (mailto:, tel: / sms:)
Modern, 'no-BS' UI focused on direct connection
features.notes: Facilitates personal, high-touch communication for agency lead-generation.

features.name: Disruptive Brand Visuals
features.description: High-end UI framework using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion to convey a disruptive but stable image.
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode default with premium glassmorphism effects
Intentional motion and transitions (e.g., counting up outcome numbers)
Strict typography (e.g., Inter or Geist) for technical trust
features.notes: Key differentiator from stale competitors in regulated spaces.
